verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence touching search is Asana's official MCP server, whose docs show querying tasks in natural language ("Find all my incomplete tasks due this week") through read tools that return workspace data. That is a thin, glancing form of task lookup routed through an AI client, not a documented unified search experience. Gemini Enterprise's cross-app search is a third-party integration and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented native search across tasks, docs, and comments; evidence of search over comments or docs at all; any evidence of speed or result accuracy; independent or hands-on corroboration.
